scope: Research evidence screening, not model validation or pilot participation.

observed_file_summary.parsing: UTF-8 TSV; whitespace trimmed from headers only; decimal commas parsed explicitly for this source; original files unchanged.

datasets.intended_audit_role: Laboratory transcription and source-definition review only.
reviewer_assessed_limitations: Rice-field chemistry is not an irrigation-event time series or validation of vegetable irrigation.
Per-sample collection/report dates, daily weather and applied irrigation are absent from the numeric table.
Dictionary contains inconsistent site-count and potassium-ion wording; retain original definitions for clarification.
No automatic soil-test interpretation, soil-water initialization or fertilizer targets are justified.

observed_file_summary.parsing: CSV decoded as Windows-1252 (audit choice); no date/time interpretation, unit conversion or video download.

datasets.intended_audit_role: Discharge metadata and evaluation-split preparation only; no videos downloaded.
reviewer_assessed_limitations: Iranian fields do not establish Burkina Faso or Taiwan performance.
Relative pressure categories cannot become measured pressure/head inputs.
Wind was not instrumentally measured; the numeric table lacks surveyed pipes, nozzle curves and collection-can distributions.
Paired recordings must stay together in any future evaluation split; no split or prediction test has been performed.
Dates and local times are retained as supplied; no timezone or date-order interpretation is inferred.

datasets.intended_audit_role: Candidate only; publication metadata and README inspected, numeric archive unavailable in this audit.
reviewer_assessed_limitations: The README describes daily sensor summaries; these are not instantaneous end-of-day soil-state readings.
Actual CSV columns, missingness, sensor depth and units have not been inspected.
No timestamps, observation quality or irrigation validation metrics are fabricated.

conclusion: No candidate in this screening supplies a complete held-out validation case for the implemented irrigation models. No performance score, field-validation status, pilot partnership or observed farm record was created.
